findings.publisher: WAFA, attributing figures to UNICEF regional office; independent contemporary secondary account in See News quoting UNICEF regional spokesperson Salim Oweis
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinian children in Gaza; cumulative casualties since the October 2025 ceasefire; humanitarian water, shelter and sanitation needs

findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency citing UNICEF regional office; separately reported UNICEF spokesperson remarks; direct Nov 15 UNICEF primary bulletin not located
findings.summary: WAFA reports a UNICEF regional office statement giving cumulative figures of 360 children killed and over 1,700 injured since the ceasefire, and stating that access restrictions on shelter materials and water/wastewater spare parts persist. See News independently reports the same two cumulative figures, attributing them to UNICEF regional spokesperson Salim Oweis in remarks to Al-Qahera News. This is a newly surfaced cumulative statistical update, NOT 360 or 1,700 new casualties in the past hour, and not a demonstrated new service closure. UNICEF's October 7 and 16 publications described over 340 killed; case dates and precise census cutoff for the new figures are unverified.
